notes: Amendatory bill (amends 26 U.S.C. 3306(t)). Source on file is the INTRODUCED (IH) version (subsections a-f); registered referencedSource usc-26-3306 (2024 edition) fully covers pre-amendment subsection (t) and confirms all struck/base language. All core structural claims SUPPORTED with no figure errors (5 and 10 verbatim in Section 2(d); 5 percent verbatim in ref (t)(4)) and no direction inversions. 0 material. 7 minor: (1) underreported/likelihoodReason recast the bill's PERMISSIVE 2-year state-amendment clause (Section 2(e)) as a mandatory 'states must amend to be compliant' obligation [may->must, 3 rows]; (2) 'attract broad support' and 'Senate floor time limited' are unsourced likelihoodReason framing (rubric class 8 style debt); (3) '[trust funds] vary significantly in reserves across states' is extrinsic context in gaps; (4) 'gaps' 6 cosponsors vs 5 named in introduced text (external metadata). CAVEAT: bill stage is 'Passed House' (Engrossed 2026-04-27) but source file is Introduced; versionChanges asserts the Engrossed version added a subsection (g) Secretary-of-Labor guidance directive not present in the source on file and therefore neither verifiable nor coverable here — recommend refetching the Engrossed text and re-auditing if (g) is operative.
